title: Tone experiments with entranced space kids

tellings.quote: while they're in a trance, there's a lot of experiments where like, I'm going to play this certain tone, and can you kind

plain: In the 1970s, in the lab of a scientist named Andrija Puharich, children nicknamed the "space kids" were said to be put into trances and tested: tones were played to them, and they were asked to respond while still in trance. An unnamed researcher on the show describes this from the tapes of Puharich's sessions, as part of a story about a scientist who is said to have contacted an alien council through such sessions.
